name: Carl Weber's The Family Business
description: Meet the Duncans, a prominent family from Jamaica, Queens. By day, they’re an upstanding family; by night, they live a dangerous secret life.

videos.title: We Are at War
videos.overview: L.C. Duncan has decided it's finally time to pass on the mantle of leadership. All this during a time when their Asian supplier has cut them off, and their rivals are threatening to put them out of business.

videos.title: The Games Have Just Begun
videos.overview: Miguel faces consequences for seeing Paris, L.C. accuses Alejandro of stealing his shipment, Rio goes on a dangerous mission, and Orlando meets with Vegas.

videos.title: Show Down
videos.overview: LC’s been shot and is near death. In Godfather-style closure, the Duncans challenge their enemies, which includes forcing Harris to make a very personal decision.

videos.title: Answered Questions
videos.overview: The Duncans are still dealing with the ramifications of the past. Vinnie Dash, the only remaining son of Sal, is still on the loose and dangerous. LC’s grandson, Nevada, is starting to ask questions that make his grandparents nervous.

videos.title: The Heat is On
videos.overview: The Duncans are preparing to head to their Hamptons retreat when they get the call that London has gone into labor. The family excitedly waits for a new addition, while Orlando explains HEAT, the drug he’s invented. The family says goodbye to Lou.

videos.title: A Death In The Family
videos.overview: The Duncans send Junior and Paris to search for a killer. HEAT is a big hit, and everyone is excited about the possibilities—except Chippy. A Duncan dies at the hands of the Zunigas.

videos.title: Home Coming
videos.overview: LC visits Randy in the hospital. Orlando Duncan's body is returned. Sasha travels to New York to confront LC Duncan.

videos.title: Mexican Stand Off
videos.overview: The Duncans celebrate the new addition to their family; Consuela challenges the Duncans’ stronghold; the truth about Nevada Duncan is revealed.

videos.title: Back To Life
videos.overview: The Duncans deal with a shocking revelation about their enemy and LC sits down with the underworld leaders to discuss the future of HEAT while new threats appear.

videos.title: Put A Ring On It
videos.overview: There are wedding bells in the Duncans' future as Junior prepares to pop the question. Niles and Paris reunite and Donna Duncan returns to make Chippy's life miserable.

videos.title: Introducing Brother X
videos.overview: The Duncan family receive a clear message that an imminent inter-family war looms on the horizon. Sonya's husband and Elijah's boss, the incarcerated assassin Brother X, arrive.

videos.title: Heat It Up!
videos.overview: Things spin out of control for the family as London teams up with Sasha in an attempt to hunt down Brother X and Elijah. Meanwhile, Paris is in Europe.

videos.title: You Can Run But You Can't Hide
videos.overview: The Duncans all turn up the heat in their search for Brother X, while Harris takes one for the team to get the job done. Bernie finally shows his true colors.

videos.title: Casualties of War
videos.overview: As the war intensifies, Orlando sits down with Elijah just as one of the Duncan faithful goes down in a blaze of bullets and a family member is taken prisoner.

videos.title: Take No Prisoners
videos.overview: Brother X fails to assassinate LC and Chippy. However, things are far from over, as he has accidentally captured a Duncan during the attack. Paris, London and Sasha launch a rescue mission.

videos.title: The Nuclear Option
videos.overview: Orlando vows to get revenge for Kennedy, Sasha's captors try to get information out of her, and the Duncans seek support in their war against the Brotherhood.

videos.title: Mothers and Their Sons
videos.overview: Junior and Sonya make landfall in Cuba. Chippy and Nevada take a trip and Consuela seeks protection from her husband Alejandro. A mysterious figure named Sage is introduced.

videos.title: I Don't Want To Lose My Queen
videos.overview: Returning home, Junior receives words of wisdom from a family member. As Brother X falls further into bloodlust, a new enemy lurks in the shadows.

videos.title: Deploy The Drones
videos.overview: The Duncans move in to rescue Sasha and eliminate Brother X. Consuela receives new intel on Alejandro. Sebastian makes a deal with the devil.

videos.title: The Hunt for Brother X
videos.overview: As his sons hunt down Brother X, LC decides Elijah's fate. Meanwhile, Billionaire Alexander Cora plots against the unsuspecting Duncans to take over HEAT.

videos.title: The Heat Is On
videos.overview: Who is the new mystery man looking for Brother X? Billionaire Alexander Cora emerges from behind the scenes and is one step closer to replicating HEAT.

videos.title: Who Is Curtis Duncan
videos.overview: Curtis Duncan arrives at the Duncan Estate to mixed emotions from his family. Brandi is given a final warning. Alexander Cora's dissatisfaction with Sebastian has dire consequences.

videos.title: The Hunt For Consuela
videos.overview: Juan Rodriguez recruits the Duncans and their underworld table to help in his search for Consuela, but the response is not what he's expecting.

videos.title: What's Better Than Heat? Fire!!!
videos.overview: Alexanders dream of his own HEAT has come true thanks to Brandi and her new creation called: FIRE. An old rivalry between the Duncans heats up.

videos.title: Time to Start Washing the Money
videos.overview: With Bernie's help, Alexander Cora begins distribution of FIRE. Meanwhile an unsuspecting LC sends Curtis and Sasha to help out Rio in Miami.

videos.title: Blood on your Hands
videos.overview: Curtis returns to a tragedy and places the blame squarely on Orlando's shoulders. Michael Diamond has finally been found.

videos.title: Brotherly Love
videos.overview: LC takes a long avoided trip to see his brother Larry Duncan. FIRE is quietly beginning to take over the streets as Alexander sits back and counts his money.

videos.title: Money has no Friends
videos.overview: Key Duncan allies abandon them for FIRE. Senor Cruz may have the key to turning things around for the Duncans but he has his own personal tragedy to deal with.

videos.title: Brother X Strikes Again
videos.overview: Chippy and Curtis just miss capturing Brother X who strikes back hard killing a key Duncan Ally.

videos.title: Bye, Bye Harris
videos.overview: Harris' secret is out and Nevada decides its time to take matters in his own hands. London must now choose what is best for her.

videos.title: Clear the Table
videos.overview: Despite the TABLE deserting the Duncan men's problem with HEAT the Duncans women go out to celebrate Junior and Sonyas's coming nuptial.

videos.title: Flipping the Script
videos.overview: The defeated Duncans sit down with Alexander Cora to discuss terms on selling HEAT. Junior and Sonya's drama filled wedding.

videos.title: Crazy as Duncans
videos.overview: L.C. tries to keep Cruz from exacting revenge on Alexander, the police stop by Fresh Meadows to investigate a missing person case, and Junior takes on new responsibilities.Larry hires new staff as he continues his takeover of Fresh Meadows; Junior gets a promotion; the Duncans throw a farewell dinner for Curtis; the Hellfire Club has its grand reopening.

videos.title: Everybody Wants Harris
videos.overview: Harris finds himself in high demand after parting ways with the Duncans, Elijah prepares to propose to Sasha, and Consuela hatches a plan to profit off her client’s information.

videos.title: Family First
videos.overview: With Curtis on Kenny's trail, his sister Lauryn visits the Duncans for reinforcement. Elijah visits Donna to ask her a serious question.

videos.title: Trigger Happy
videos.overview: Danielle meets a big client; Orlando searches for a bone marrow transplant for Vincent; L.C. learns of a string of murders; Larry threatens Donna in her home.

videos.title: Dead Silence
videos.overview: Larry silences Donna and a love one is dead. Vinny and Orlando clash over Vincent's treatment; Lauryn discovers just how far Kenny has fallen; Antonio forges an important new alliance; the family makes a tragic discovery.

videos.title: Home Coming
videos.overview: As Consuela's new Hellfire Club expands, her top girl gets a new client who is trigger happy. Orlando is willing to kill anyone who gets in the way of him seeing his son. Elijah is grief-stricken; Paris recruits Curtis and Nevada to help her catch a killer; L.C. faces a new danger.

videos.title: Vengeance Is Mine
videos.overview: When LC goes missing, Chippy must find him by all means necessary before everything falls apart.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: With their backs against the wall, The Duncans take a huge gamble and play their hold card.

videos.title: Seeing Things
videos.overview: With the entire Duncan clan searching for a missing LC - He has an unexpected visitor, a blast from the past, but is it too late?

videos.title: Rise or Fall
videos.overview: With the walls falling down all around the Duncans, LC's life hangs in the balance.

videos.title: The Aftermath
videos.overview: The Duncans try to put the pieces of their fractured family back together after Uncle Larry's rampage and Junior's revelation.

videos.title: Desperate Times, Desperate Measures
videos.overview: LC goes to desperate lengths to protect his son Vegas and keep secrets of the past from boiling over.

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: Paris reveals the truth about her past with Niles and recruits Curtis to solve the blue roses mystery.

videos.title: Reminisce
videos.overview: In a blast from the past, Chippy and Donna separately reminisce over their long-ago doomed love triangle with LC.

videos.title: Choices and Consequences
videos.overview: The walls are closing in on the Duncans as choices they've made in the past begin to haunt them.

videos.title: Crossing Boundaries
videos.overview: The marching orders given to Donna have Junior on edge.

videos.title: In Plain Sight
videos.overview: Paris enlists Brother Elijah's help, Vegas gets some eye-opening information from K.D. about L.C.'s recent activities, and the Duncan brothers end up in hot water while looking for answers.

videos.title: Chickens Come Home To Roost
videos.overview: Paris comes clean with Bobby. Sonya confronts Junior, and there's hell to pay. Rio's search for his carjacker leads to a revelation he never expected.

videos.title: One Step Closer
videos.overview: Donna proves her loyalty and is seen in a new light. Sonya's secret is out, and the clock is ticking. Paris and Curtis come one step closer to finding Niles.

videos.title: All is Fair in Love and War
videos.overview: Junior pleads for Sonya to take him back in hopes of saving his family. After a loss of one of their own, The Table learns of their new enemy: The Alliance. Rio returns home with an unexpected guest. Junior finally steps into his own and declares war.

videos.title: Welcome to the Family...Not!
videos.overview: The Duncans grapple with the surprising news of Roman's abduction and Brother Elijah vows revenge; Junior and his allies make another move against their rivals.

videos.title: My Son, the Thief
videos.overview: L.C. scrambles to keep the peace when Junior and his allies steal millions in cash from a Duncan truck; Roman struggles with his new life as a Duncan while mourning his adoptive mother.

videos.title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
videos.overview: LC's plan to take down Senator Pettway and the Dixie Mafia finally comes to fruition; the boomerang effect of that retaliation could land Vegas back in jail or worse; Paris begins to plot against Bobby.

videos.title: More Than Meets the Eye
videos.overview: The Alliance mourns the death of one of their own; Sonya pleads for her husband, Junior's life, as Brother Elijah and the Brotherhood sets their target on him.

videos.title: A Ring on Your Finger and Blood on Your Hands
videos.overview: Paris befriends Karen and Vegas confides in London; as Juan and Consuela celebrate their nuptials, L.C. finally comes face-to-face with Junior with explosive, life-altering results.

videos.title: Only A Duncan can Kill a Duncan
videos.overview: A vengeful death at the hands of the Alliance is a step too far for both Junior and his estranged family; unpredictable Uncle Larry agrees to carry out an unthinkable deed for L.C.

videos.title: This Is Going to Hurt Me More Than You
videos.overview: A grief-stricken Donna finds solace in her surprising secret lover and Chippy visits Vincent's potential bone marrow donor in prison; Karen catches Bobby in a compromising position.

videos.title: One Life to Live
videos.overview: Paris escalates her plan to destroy Bobby, London gets a romantic surprise, and the family is thrilled when Randy appears willing to save Vincent, but he has more selfish plans.

videos.title: Duncan Down
videos.overview: Vincent's life hangs in the balance as the Duncan family works together to track down devious Uncle Randy before law enforcement intervenes.

videos.title: It All Comes Down to This...
videos.overview: An enraged Bobby confronts Paris, Sonya goes into labor, Donna steps into her power with the Alliance, and with Randy out of the picture, a surprise donor emerges to save Vincent's life.
